### The Names of God
Author: Donny Friederichsen
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-names-of-god
Passage: Exodus 6:1-3
Points:
- Moses and the Israelites faced severe discouragement when Pharaoh increased their oppression instead of freeing them.
- God assured Moses that Pharaoh's own hand would eventually drive Israel out under divine compulsion.
- God revealed Himself as El Shaddai to demonstrate His supreme power to accomplish whatever He wills.
- God also revealed His name Yahweh to underscore His personal, covenant relationship with His people.
- In Christ, the Almighty God has drawn near to comfort believers and prove that He is mighty to save.

### God the Deliverer
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-deliverer
Passage: Exodus 6:6
Points:
- Israel's painful servitude in Egypt serves as a historical picture of humanity's deeper exile under sin.
- God pledged to redeem the Israelites from bondage by His outstretched arm and mighty acts of judgment.
- Deliverance requires people to abandon self-rescue efforts and place their trust entirely in God.
- The Lord's ancient promise finds ultimate fulfillment in Christ, who rescues believers from eternal bondage.
- Redemption and restoration to God come solely through faith in the great Deliverer.

### Bible Pathways - January 19, 2006
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-january-19-2006-1373894.html
Passage: Exodus 6:6
Points:
- When circumstances worsen and trials seem inexplicable, believers often struggle with difficult questions.
- Rather than answering every question, God responds by reminding His servants of who He is.
- God repeatedly declared His covenant commitment to free Israel from their heavy burdens.
- God never fails to keep His word, though His promises rarely unfold according to human timing.
- Christ fulfills the Exodus promise of redemption by releasing believers from sin through His blood.
